subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Humble
solution:
The correct answer is **"Modest".**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__ **

 
• **Humble **means ​'not thinking that he/she is better or more important than other people; not proud (**विनम्र, विनीत; घमंडी नहीं**)**'.**

 
 
• ​Example: *Andriana has risen from **humble **origins to immense wealth.*
 
 
 
• Marked option&nb
